purpose: Every part the build puts in the packaged application folder's runtime folder, pinned by SHA-256. The build fetches each into its own cache (a .partial file, checked, then renamed) and stops on any mismatch. The speech libraries are not here: they are downloaded on the user's PC at first launch (speech-lock.json).

python.name: Python 3.12.10 embeddable package (amd64)
python.licence: PSF-2.0 (with the licences of the software it incorporates)
python.stdlib_left_out_why: cgitb (a CGI error-page helper, deprecated and removed in Python 3.13) is never used, and its sample file:// address trips the package privacy check.

ffmpeg.name: FFmpeg 8.1 from FFmpeg-Builds, win64 gpl-shared, the October 2026 month-end build
ffmpeg.source: The complete Corresponding Source is built from the pin list in ffmpeg-source-pins.json (tools/installer/ffmpeg_source_bundle.py) and offered next to each release.
publish_blockers: This build links libzvbi, whose src/packet-830.c and src/pdc.c are GPL-2.0-only, into avcodec-62.dll of a GPL-3.0-or-later build; the two cannot be combined. Upstream stopped building zvbi into GPL builds on 2026-11-07 (FFmpeg-Builds commit 162691525a439dbec17f5d01a8d241f134b7516d). Pin a later month-end build before any release.

openai_whisper.name: openai-whisper (source, built into a wheel by the build with no pip and no network)

setuptools.name: setuptools (used by the build only, to turn the Whisper source into a wheel; never shipped)

truststore.name: truststore (checks download certificates through Windows' own certificate verification)

vc_runtime.name: Microsoft Visual C++ runtime, placed beside our own Python
vc_runtime.licence: Microsoft Visual Studio redistributable files terms
vc_runtime.source: Microsoft-signed files installed by Microsoft's Visual C++ redistributable; the build takes them from its own cache, or from the build PC's System32, and accepts each only when its SHA-256 matches the pin below and its signature is valid and Microsoft's.
